content.q: The hard outer layer of a tooth is called ___.
content.tip: Enamel là chất cứng nhất cơ thể.
content.why: **enamel** = men răng, lớp ngoài cùng và cứng nhất.

content.q: The soft centre of a tooth that contains nerves and blood vessels is the ___.
content.why: **pulp** = tủy răng, chứa dây thần kinh và mạch máu.

content.q: Adults normally have 32 permanent teeth, including four ___, which often appear late.
content.why: **wisdom teeth** = răng khôn, thường mọc ở tuổi 17 đến 25.

content.q: The sharp front teeth used for cutting food are called ___.
content.why: **incisors** = răng cửa, dùng để cắt thức ăn.

content.q: ___ are the large, flat teeth at the back of the mouth that grind food.
content.why: **Molars** = răng hàm, nghiền thức ăn.

content.q: A soft, sticky film of bacteria on the teeth is called ___.
content.why: **plaque** = mảng bám răng, màng vi khuẩn mềm dính.

content.q: If plaque is not removed, it hardens into ___.
content.why: **tartar** (calculus) = cao răng, mảng bám đã cứng lại.

content.q: A hole in a tooth caused by decay is called a ___.
content.why: **cavity** = lỗ sâu răng.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Hiện tại đơn và hiện tại tiếp diễn
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form.
exercises.instruction_vi: Ngữ pháp: sự thật/thói quen dùng hiện tại đơn; việc đang xảy ra dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn.

content.q: Enamel ___ the tooth from acids and bacteria.
content.why: Chức năng cố định, chủ ngữ số ít → **protects**.

content.q: The dentist ___ the patient's teeth right now.
content.why: 'right now' → **is examining**.

content.q: Children usually ___ 20 baby teeth.

content.why: **have** là động từ chỉ trạng thái; usually → hiện tại đơn.

content.why: 'Look!' → **is losing**.

content.q: I ___ a course on dental anatomy this semester.
content.why: Việc tạm thời, đang diễn ra → **am taking**.

content.q: The pulp ___ nerves and blood vessels.
content.tip: contain là động từ trạng thái.
content.why: Sự thật, chủ ngữ số ít → **contains**.

exercises.title: Bài 3 · Danh từ đếm được, không đếm được và lượng từ
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form.
exercises.instruction_vi: Ngữ pháp: many/a few/few + đếm được; much/a little/little + không đếm được; some/any dùng cho cả hai.

content.q: How ___ teeth does an adult have?
content.why: **teeth** đếm được → **many**.

content.q: There isn't ___ plaque on your molars.
content.why: plaque không đếm được → **much**.

content.q: I have ___ cavities, but only two are deep.
content.why: **a few** + danh từ đếm được số nhiều.

content.q: Rinse your mouth with ___ water after eating.
content.why: **a little** + danh từ không đếm được.

content.q: Are there ___ problems with your gums?
content.why: Câu hỏi với danh từ số nhiều → **any**.

content.q: There is too ___ tartar on your lower incisors.
content.why: too much + danh từ không đếm được.

content.why: **attached to**.

content.q: The premolars are ___ the canines and the molars.
content.why: **between**.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · What is a tooth made of?
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
A tooth looks simple, but it has several layers. The visible part is called the crown. It is covered with enamel, the hardest substance in the human body. Under the enamel there is dentine, which is softer and slightly yellow. In the centre, the pulp contains nerves and blood vessels. The root holds the tooth in the jawbone, and it is surrounded by the gum.

Humans have two sets of teeth. Children have 20 baby teeth, which begin to fall out at about the age of six. Adults usually have 32 permanent teeth. Incisors cut food, canines tear it, and premolars and molars grind it. The last molars, called wisdom teeth, often appear between the ages of 17 and 25, and sometimes there is not enough space for them.

Teeth need daily care. Bacteria in the mouth form plaque, a soft film that produces acid. If plaque is not removed, it hardens into tartar, and the acid can make a cavity in the enamel.

content.q: Enamel is softer than dentine.
content.why: Đoạn 1: men răng là chất cứng nhất cơ thể; ngà răng mềm hơn.

content.q: The pulp contains nerves and blood vessels.
content.why: Đoạn 1: tủy răng chứa dây thần kinh và mạch máu.

content.q: Adults usually have 20 permanent teeth.
content.why: Đoạn 2: người lớn thường có 32 răng vĩnh viễn; trẻ em có 20 răng sữa.

content.q: Plaque can harden into tartar.
content.why: Đoạn 3: mảng bám không loại bỏ sẽ cứng lại thành cao răng.

content.q: What is the visible part of the tooth called?
content.why: Đoạn 1: phần nhìn thấy gọi là thân răng (crown).

content.q: What do canines do?
content.why: Đoạn 2: răng nanh xé thức ăn.

content.q: When do wisdom teeth often appear?
content.why: Đoạn 2: răng khôn thường mọc ở tuổi 17 đến 25.

content.q: What makes the acid that can cause a cavity?
content.why: Đoạn 3: vi khuẩn trong mảng bám tạo ra axit.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · A day in a dental clinic
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
The dental team starts work at eight o'clock. Before the first patient arrives, the dental assistant prepares the surgery: she sets out the instruments, checks the equipment and cleans the chair. The dentist reads the patient's notes carefully because every patient needs a different kind of care.

At nine o'clock, Mr Hoang comes for a check-up. The dentist examines his teeth with a mirror and a probe and notices a small cavity in a molar. She explains the problem and offers a filling. Meanwhile, the dental hygienist is cleaning another patient's teeth. She removes plaque and tartar and shows the patient how to brush properly.

Everyone in a dental team has a different role, but they work together. The dentist diagnoses and treats problems, the hygienist focuses on prevention, and the assistant helps during procedures. At the end of the day, the team sterilises all the instruments so that the clinic is safe for the next day.

content.q: The dental assistant prepares the surgery before the first patient arrives.
content.why: Đoạn 1: trợ lý chuẩn bị phòng khám, dụng cụ và ghế.

content.q: The dentist uses a mirror and a probe to examine the teeth.
content.why: Đoạn 2: nha sĩ khám bằng gương và cây thăm dò.

content.q: The hygienist's main job is to fill cavities.
content.why: Đoạn 3: vệ sinh viên tập trung vào phòng ngừa; nha sĩ chẩn đoán và điều trị.

content.q: The team sterilises the instruments at the start of the day.
content.why: Đoạn 3: tiệt trùng dụng cụ vào cuối ngày.

content.q: What does the dentist notice in Mr Hoang's mouth?
content.why: Đoạn 2: một lỗ sâu nhỏ ở răng hàm.
opts: A small cavity in a molar

content.q: What does the hygienist show the patient?
content.why: Đoạn 2: chị hướng dẫn cách đánh răng đúng.

content.q: Who helps the dentist during procedures?
content.why: Đoạn 3: trợ lý nha khoa hỗ trợ trong thủ thuật.

content.q: Why does the dentist read the patient's notes carefully?
content.why: Đoạn 1: mỗi bệnh nhân cần cách chăm sóc khác nhau.
opts: Every patient needs a different kind of care.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Cấu trúc câu hỏi
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form.

content.tip: Câu hỏi chủ ngữ: Which + V.
content.why: Which tooth là chủ ngữ → không cần trợ động từ: **hurts**.

content.q: ___ you allergic to any medicine?

content.q: Who ___ you to our clinic?

exercises.title: Bài 1 · A first visit to the dentist
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Linh is 28 and she has toothache. She phones a clinic and makes an appointment for the next morning. At reception she fills in a form about her medical history. She writes that she is allergic to penicillin, and the nurse notes it on her chart.

The dentist asks several questions. Where is the pain? When did it start? Is it worse with hot or cold drinks? Linh says that it started three days ago while she was eating ice cream. Then the dentist examines her mouth with a mirror and a probe. She taps the tooth gently, which is called a percussion test, and applies a cold test. The tooth is very sensitive.

Next, the dentist takes a bitewing X-ray. It shows deep decay close to the pulp in a lower molar. The dentist explains the diagnosis and the treatment plan: a filling, or root canal treatment if the pulp is infected. Linh signs the consent form and books a second appointment.

content.q: Linh made an appointment for the following week.
content.why: Đoạn 1: cô đặt lịch vào sáng hôm sau.

content.q: Linh is allergic to penicillin.
content.why: Đoạn 1: cô ghi rõ mình dị ứng penicillin.

content.q: The pain started while she was eating ice cream.
content.why: Đoạn 2: cơn đau bắt đầu 3 ngày trước khi đang ăn kem.

content.q: The X-ray shows that the molar is healthy.
content.why: Đoạn 3: phim cho thấy sâu răng sâu gần tủy.

content.q: Why does the nurse note Linh's allergy on her chart?
content.why: Đoạn 1: ghi vào hồ sơ để cả nhóm biết dị ứng của cô.
opts: So the team knows about it

content.q: What does the dentist find with the cold test?
content.why: Đoạn 2: răng rất ê buốt.

content.q: What does the bitewing X-ray show?
content.why: Đoạn 3: sâu răng sâu gần tủy ở răng hàm dưới.
opts: Deep decay close to the pulp

content.q: What does Linh do at the end of the visit?
content.why: Đoạn 3: cô ký phiếu đồng ý và đặt lịch hẹn thứ hai.
opts: She signs the consent form and books a second appointment.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Which X-ray should I use?
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Dentists use X-rays because many problems cannot be seen with the eye. There are three common types. A bitewing X-ray shows the crowns of the upper and lower back teeth. It is the best way to find decay between teeth. A periapical X-ray shows a whole tooth, from the crown to the root tip, so it helps to detect an abscess. A panoramic X-ray shows both jaws, all the teeth and the jaw joints in one picture.

When a dentist needs more detail, for example before placing an implant, a CBCT scan gives a 3D image. The patient stands or sits while a machine rotates around the head for about 20 seconds.

X-rays use a low dose of radiation. The dose from a bitewing is very small, but dentists still follow a simple rule: only take an X-ray when it is necessary. Patients wear a lead apron, and women who are pregnant should always tell the dentist before an X-ray.

content.q: A bitewing X-ray is good for finding decay between teeth.
content.why: Đoạn 1: bitewing là cách tốt nhất tìm sâu kẽ răng.

content.q: A panoramic X-ray shows only one tooth.
content.why: Đoạn 1: toàn cảnh cho thấy cả hai hàm, mọi răng và khớp hàm.

content.q: A CBCT scan gives a 3D image.
content.why: Đoạn 2: CBCT cho hình ảnh 3D.

content.q: Dentists take an X-ray at every visit, even when it is not necessary.
content.why: Đoạn 3: quy tắc: chỉ chụp khi cần thiết.

content.q: What does a periapical X-ray help to detect?
content.why: Đoạn 1: periapical cho thấy cả răng từ thân đến chóp nên giúp phát hiện áp-xe.

content.q: How long does a CBCT scan take?
content.why: Đoạn 2: máy quay quanh đầu khoảng 20 giây.

content.q: When is a CBCT scan used?
content.why: Đoạn 2: khi cần nhiều chi tiết hơn, ví dụ trước khi cấy implant.
opts: When more detail is needed, for example before an implant

content.q: What should pregnant women do before an X-ray?
content.why: Đoạn 3: phụ nữ mang thai luôn phải báo cho nha sĩ trước khi chụp.

content.q: The dentist removed the decay and placed a tooth-coloured ___ in the cavity.

content.q: ___ is a tooth-coloured material made of plastic and fine glass particles.

content.q: The dentist uses a ___ to harden the filling material in a few seconds.
content.why: **curing light** = đèn quang trùng hợp, làm cứng composite.

content.q: A ___ keeps the tooth dry and separates it from the saliva during treatment.
content.why: **rubber dam** = đê cao su, cô lập răng khỏi nước bọt.

content.q: The dentist used a small ___ on the handpiece to remove the decay.
content.why: **bur** = mũi khoan gắn trên tay khoan.

content.q: A ___ is a thin, tooth-coloured shell bonded to the front of a tooth to improve its appearance.
content.why: **veneer** = mặt dán sứ ở mặt ngoài răng.

content.q: During root canal treatment, the dentist cleans the canals with small ___ and a washing liquid.
content.why: **endodontic files** = trâm nội nha, làm sạch ống tủy.

content.q: A ___ protects the tooth while the permanent crown is being made in the laboratory.
content.why: **temporary crown** = mão tạm, bảo vệ răng trong thời gian chờ.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Having a filling
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
A filling is the most common dental treatment. It is used when a tooth has a cavity caused by decay. First, the dentist gives a local anaesthetic, so the patient feels no pain. Then the decayed tissue is removed with a handpiece and a bur. The cavity is cleaned and dried, and sometimes a rubber dam is placed around the tooth to keep it dry.

Next, the dentist chooses the material. Amalgam is strong and cheap, but it is silver in colour. Composite resin matches the colour of the tooth, so it is popular for front teeth. The composite is applied in thin layers, and each layer is hardened with a curing light for a few seconds. Finally, the dentist shapes and polishes the filling and checks the bite.

Patients should not eat until the numbness has gone. A small amount of sensitivity is normal for a few days. If the bite feels high or the pain gets worse, the patient should return to the clinic.

content.q: A rubber dam is sometimes placed to keep the tooth dry.
content.why: Đoạn 1: đê cao su giữ răng khô.

content.q: Amalgam has the same colour as the tooth.
content.why: Đoạn 2: amalgam có màu bạc; composite mới cùng màu răng.

content.q: Composite is hardened with a curing light.
content.why: Đoạn 2: từng lớp được làm cứng bằng đèn quang trùng hợp.

content.q: Patients can eat immediately after the anaesthetic.
content.why: Đoạn 3: bệnh nhân không nên ăn cho đến khi hết tê.

content.q: Why is local anaesthetic given first?
content.why: Đoạn 1: gây tê để bệnh nhân không đau.
opts: So that the patient feels no pain

content.q: Why is composite popular for front teeth?
content.why: Đoạn 2: composite cùng màu răng nên phổ biến ở răng cửa.
opts: It matches the colour of the tooth.

content.q: What does the dentist check at the end?
content.why: Đoạn 2: cuối cùng nha sĩ tạo hình, đánh bóng và kiểm tra khớp cắn.

content.q: What should the patient do if the bite feels high?
content.why: Đoạn 3: cảm giác cộm hoặc đau tăng thì quay lại phòng khám.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Root canal treatment: myth and reality
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Many people are afraid of root canal treatment, but it is usually no more painful than a filling. The treatment is necessary when the pulp is infected or badly damaged, for example after deep decay or a crack. If the infected pulp is not removed, bacteria can spread and cause an abscess.

During treatment, the dentist numbs the tooth and makes a small opening in the crown. The pulp chamber is cleaned with tiny files, and the canals are washed with an antibacterial liquid. The canals are then dried and filled with gutta-percha. Finally, the opening is closed with a filling.

Because a tooth without a pulp is more fragile, it is often covered with a crown afterwards. This protects the tooth from breaking. With good care, a tooth that has had root canal treatment can last for many years. The most important thing is to treat the problem early: the sooner the patient comes, the easier the treatment is.

content.q: Root canal treatment is usually much more painful than a filling.
content.why: Đoạn 1: thường không đau hơn trám răng.

content.q: The treatment is needed when the pulp is infected or badly damaged.
content.why: Đoạn 1: cần điều trị tủy khi tủy bị nhiễm trùng hoặc tổn thương nặng.

content.q: The canals are filled with gutta-percha.
content.why: Đoạn 2: ống tủy được làm khô rồi trám bằng gutta-percha.

content.q: A tooth without a pulp is stronger than a normal tooth.
content.why: Đoạn 3: răng mất tủy giòn hơn.

content.q: What can happen if infected pulp is not removed?
content.why: Đoạn 1: vi khuẩn lan rộng gây áp-xe.
opts: Bacteria can spread and cause an abscess.

content.q: What is used to clean the pulp chamber?
content.why: Đoạn 2: buồng tủy được làm sạch bằng trâm nhỏ.

content.q: Why is a crown often placed afterwards?
content.why: Đoạn 3: răng không tủy giòn hơn nên cần mão răng bảo vệ.

content.q: What makes treatment easier?
content.why: Đoạn 3: đến sớm thì điều trị dễ hơn.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Removing a wisdom tooth
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Wisdom teeth often cause problems because there is not enough space in the jaw. An impacted wisdom tooth may push against the next tooth, trap food and cause infection. When this happens, the dentist or oral surgeon usually recommends extraction.

Before the operation, an X-ray shows the position of the tooth and the nerve. The patient receives a local anaesthetic, and sometimes sedation if he or she is nervous. The surgeon makes an incision in the gum, lifts a flap and removes a little bone if necessary. The tooth is then loosened with an elevator and removed with forceps. Finally, the wound is closed with sutures.

Recovery takes about one week. Swelling and bruising are normal, and an ice pack helps. The patient should not rinse vigorously or use a straw, because these can remove the blood clot and cause a dry socket. A painkiller and, if needed, an antibiotic are prescribed.

content.q: Wisdom teeth often cause problems because there is not enough space.
content.why: Đoạn 1: hàm không đủ chỗ.

content.q: The surgeon uses an elevator to close the wound.
content.why: Đoạn 2: bẩy dùng làm lung lay răng; vết thương được đóng bằng chỉ khâu.

content.q: Bruising is normal after the operation.
content.why: Đoạn 3: sưng và bầm tím là bình thường.

content.q: Using a straw is recommended after extraction.
content.why: Đoạn 3: dùng ống hút có thể làm mất cục máu đông, gây viêm ổ răng khô.

content.q: What does an X-ray show before the operation?
content.why: Đoạn 2: phim cho thấy vị trí răng và dây thần kinh.
opts: The position of the tooth and the nerve

content.q: Why might the patient receive sedation?
content.why: Đoạn 2: đôi khi cho an thần nếu bệnh nhân lo lắng.

content.q: What is used to close the wound?
content.why: Đoạn 2: vết thương được khâu lại bằng chỉ khâu.

content.q: What can cause a dry socket?
content.why: Đoạn 3: súc miệng mạnh hoặc dùng ống hút làm mất cục máu đông.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Dental implants: how do they work?
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
A dental implant is a small titanium screw that replaces the root of a missing tooth. It is placed in the jawbone under local anaesthetic. Over the next three to six months, the bone grows around the screw in a process called osseointegration. This makes the implant very stable.

If the patient does not have enough bone, the surgeon may need to perform a bone graft or a sinus lift first. This adds time to the treatment, but it improves the final result. After healing, an abutment is attached to the implant, and a crown is fixed on top. The crown looks like a natural tooth.

Implants have many advantages: they feel natural, they do not damage the neighbouring teeth, and they can last more than 20 years. However, they are expensive and need good oral hygiene. Smokers and people with uncontrolled diabetes have a higher risk of failure. For this reason, the dentist always checks the patient's health before the operation.

content.q: An implant replaces the root of a missing tooth.
content.why: Đoạn 1: implant là trụ titan thay chân răng đã mất.

content.q: Osseointegration happens in about one day.
content.why: Đoạn 1: xương mọc quanh trụ trong 3 đến 6 tháng.

content.q: Implants damage the neighbouring teeth.
content.why: Đoạn 3: implant không làm hại các răng bên cạnh.

content.q: Smokers have a higher risk of implant failure.
content.why: Đoạn 3: người hút thuốc có nguy cơ thất bại cao hơn.

content.q: What may be needed if there is not enough bone?
content.why: Đoạn 2: có thể cần ghép xương hoặc nâng xoang trước.
opts: A bone graft or a sinus lift

content.q: What is attached to the implant after healing?
content.why: Đoạn 2: gắn trụ nối rồi cố định mão răng lên trên.

content.q: How long can implants last?
content.why: Đoạn 3: implant có thể tồn tại hơn 20 năm.

content.q: Why does the dentist check the patient's health first?
content.why: Đoạn 3: hút thuốc, tiểu đường không kiểm soát làm tăng nguy cơ thất bại.
opts: Some conditions increase the risk of failure.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Braces or aligners?
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Many teenagers and adults want straight teeth. There are two main choices: fixed braces and clear aligners. Fixed braces have brackets glued to the teeth and an archwire that connects them. The orthodontist adjusts the wire every four to six weeks. Braces can correct even complex problems, such as severe crowding or a crossbite, and they work all day without the patient's help.

Clear aligners are transparent plastic trays made from a digital scan. The patient changes to a new tray about every two weeks, and each tray moves the teeth a little. Aligners are less visible and can be removed for eating, but they must be worn for 20 to 22 hours a day. If the patient forgets to wear them, the treatment will take longer.

Both treatments usually last between 12 and 24 months. Afterwards, the patient must wear a retainer, because teeth tend to move back to their old position. Without a retainer, the result may not be stable.

content.q: Fixed braces have an archwire that connects the brackets.
content.why: Đoạn 1: mắc cài được nối bằng dây cung.

content.q: Aligners must be worn for only two hours a day.
content.why: Đoạn 2: phải đeo 20 đến 22 giờ mỗi ngày.

content.q: Braces can correct complex problems such as severe crowding.
content.why: Đoạn 1: niềng mắc cài sửa được cả trường hợp phức tạp.

content.q: A retainer is unnecessary after treatment.
content.why: Đoạn 3: sau điều trị phải đeo hàm duy trì.

content.q: How often does the orthodontist adjust the archwire?
content.why: Đoạn 1: chỉnh dây mỗi 4 đến 6 tuần.

content.q: Why are aligners less visible?
content.why: Đoạn 2: khay làm từ nhựa trong suốt.
opts: They are glued inside the mouth.
They are made of transparent plastic.

content.q: What happens if the patient forgets to wear the aligners?
content.why: Đoạn 2: nếu quên đeo thì điều trị kéo dài hơn.

content.q: Why must the patient wear a retainer?
content.why: Đoạn 3: răng có xu hướng dịch chuyển trở lại vị trí cũ.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Replacing missing teeth
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
When a tooth is lost, the neighbouring teeth slowly move into the gap, and the opposite tooth may grow out of position. For this reason, dentists recommend replacing missing teeth. There are three main options.

A removable denture is the cheapest option. A complete denture replaces all the teeth in a jaw, while a partial denture replaces only some of them. Dentures can be taken out for cleaning, but some patients find them loose or uncomfortable.

A bridge is fixed in the mouth. The dentist shapes the two teeth next to the gap, called abutment teeth, and cements a crown on each. The artificial tooth between them is the pontic. A bridge feels more stable than a denture, but healthy teeth must be reduced.

A dental implant is the third option. It does not need the neighbouring teeth, but it is the most expensive and it takes the longest. Today, many restorations are designed with CAD/CAM technology, which makes them more accurate. The best choice depends on the patient's health, budget and wishes.

content.q: Neighbouring teeth can move into the gap after a tooth is lost.
content.why: Đoạn 1: răng bên cạnh dần dịch vào khoảng trống.

content.q: A removable denture is the most expensive option.
content.why: Đoạn 2: hàm giả tháo lắp là lựa chọn rẻ nhất.

content.q: A bridge is fixed in the mouth.
content.why: Đoạn 3: cầu răng được cố định trong miệng.

content.q: An implant needs the neighbouring teeth to be reduced.
content.why: Đoạn 4: implant không cần mài các răng bên cạnh.

content.q: What is a pontic?
content.why: Đoạn 3: răng giả nằm giữa hai mão răng.
opts: The artificial tooth between the two crowns

content.q: What is a disadvantage of a bridge?
content.why: Đoạn 3: phải mài hai răng khỏe làm trụ.

content.q: Which option takes the longest?
content.why: Đoạn 4: implant đắt nhất và tốn nhiều thời gian nhất.

content.q: What does CAD/CAM technology do?
content.why: Đoạn 4: giúp phục hình chính xác hơn.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Gum disease: the silent problem
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Gum disease is one of the most common health problems in the world, but many people do not notice it because it is usually painless. The first stage is gingivitis. The gums become red and swollen, and they bleed when the patient brushes. At this stage the damage can be reversed with good oral hygiene and a professional clean.

If plaque and tartar stay on the teeth, the infection goes deeper. This is periodontitis. The gums pull away from the teeth, forming pockets, and the bone that supports the teeth is slowly destroyed. Eventually the teeth become loose and may fall out. The dentist measures the pocket depth with a probe to see how serious the disease is.

Treatment starts with scaling and root planing, which means cleaning below the gum line. The patient must also change their habits: brush twice a day, clean between the teeth and stop smoking. Smoking is a major risk factor because it hides the early signs. Regular recall appointments help to keep the disease under control.

content.q: Gum disease is usually very painful in the early stages.
content.why: Đoạn 1: bệnh nướu thường không đau nên nhiều người không nhận ra.

content.q: Gingivitis can be reversed with good oral hygiene.
content.why: Đoạn 1: giai đoạn này có thể hồi phục.

content.q: In periodontitis, the bone around the teeth is slowly destroyed.
content.why: Đoạn 2: xương nâng đỡ răng bị phá hủy dần.

content.q: Smoking makes gum disease easier to notice.
content.why: Đoạn 3: hút thuốc che giấu các dấu hiệu ban đầu.

content.q: What does the dentist use to measure pocket depth?
content.why: Đoạn 2: nha sĩ đo túi nha chu bằng cây thăm dò.

content.q: What is scaling and root planing?
content.why: Đoạn 3: làm sạch dưới đường viền nướu.

content.q: What are the signs of gingivitis?
content.why: Đoạn 1: nướu đỏ, sưng và chảy máu khi đánh răng.

content.q: Why do recall appointments help?
content.why: Đoạn 3: tái khám định kỳ giúp kiểm soát bệnh.
opts: They help to keep the disease under control.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Talking to anxious patients
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Many patients feel anxious before a dental appointment. Some are afraid of pain, others of the noise of the drill or of feeling helpless. A good dentist notices these feelings and responds to them with clear communication.

First, the dentist listens. She asks open questions such as 'What worries you most?' and does not interrupt. Second, she explains the treatment in simple language, avoiding technical words. Instead of saying 'we will extract the molar', she might say 'we will remove the tooth'. Third, she tells the patient what he will feel and agrees on a signal, for example raising a hand, that means 'please stop'. This gives the patient a feeling of control.

Dentists must also obtain informed consent. The patient needs to understand the benefits, the risks and the alternatives before agreeing to treatment. Finally, the dentist should keep all patient information confidential. Patients who trust their dentist are more likely to attend regular check-ups, and this is the best way to prevent serious problems.

content.q: A dentist should interrupt anxious patients quickly.
content.why: Đoạn 2: nha sĩ lắng nghe và không ngắt lời.

content.q: A hand signal can give the patient a feeling of control.
content.why: Đoạn 2: thống nhất tín hiệu như giơ tay giúp bệnh nhân cảm thấy chủ động.

content.q: Informed consent means the patient understands the benefits, risks and alternatives.
content.why: Đoạn 3: bệnh nhân phải hiểu lợi ích, rủi ro và các lựa chọn khác.

content.q: Dentists should use as many technical words as possible.
content.why: Đoạn 2: nên giải thích bằng ngôn ngữ đơn giản, tránh thuật ngữ.

content.q: Which is an example of an open question?
content.why: Đoạn 2: câu hỏi mở như 'What worries you most?'.

content.q: Why does the dentist use simple language?
content.why: Đoạn 2: tránh thuật ngữ để bệnh nhân hiểu.
opts: So the patient understands the treatment

content.q: What is the best way to prevent serious problems?
content.why: Đoạn 3: bệnh nhân tin tưởng sẽ đi khám định kỳ; đây là cách phòng ngừa tốt nhất.

content.q: What must the dentist keep confidential?
content.why: Đoạn 3: mọi thông tin của bệnh nhân phải được bảo mật.
